title: Linux Kernel USB/IP VHCI Driver Race Condition Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Linux Kernel. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the reset event. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel.
